visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens on a professional baseball field under bright, direct sunlight. A male athlete in a navy blue 'Brothers' jersey and matching baseball cap stands ready on the green grass, wearing a fielding glove. Behind him is an outfield wall featuring prominent 'FIN' and 'MAXXIS' advertising banners, with rows of red and green stadium seats rising in the background. (2) The camera tracks the player as he sprints toward his right, his head tilted back to track a ball in the air. Other figures in maroon shirts are visible in the distance near the fence line. (3) He catches the ball in stride and immediately transitions into a high-energy throwing motion, lifting his leg and whipping his arm forward to return the ball. The shadow of his athletic posture is sharp on the well-maintained lawn. (4) The shot transitions to the player and a teammate walking side-by-side toward the side of the field, both wearing navy blue uniforms. Thick green foliage and trees are visible beyond the stadium's perimeter fence in the background.
